Metadata.title: Analiza tu juicio — Analyze your legal case online
Metadata.description: Upload your legal file and receive a complete AI-powered analysis. Strengths, risks and recommendations for your case.

Login.registerSuccess: Check your inbox to confirm your account. It may take a while.

Home.headline: Analyze your case
Home.experienceSubtext: Criminal defense requires more than just legal knowledge: it demands conviction, strategy, and empathy.With years of experience and proven results, we offer clear analysis and effective solutionsto protect your rights.
Home.subhead: Upload your file or describe your case. In minutes you'll receive a complete legal analysis: strengths, risks and recommendations.
Home.creditsHint: Description only: free · With PDF: 1 credit · Results in minutes
Home.step1Desc: Write what happened or upload your legal documents (PDFs, photos).
Home.step2Desc: Our System  reviews the file and evaluates your legal situation.
Home.step3Desc: Get a clear report with strengths, risks and recommendations.
Home.caseTypesSub: Specialized in your local legal system
Home.ctaCardDesc: Get an objective analysis in less than 3 minutes, no legal knowledge required.
Home.ctaCardFinePrint: Description-only analysis: free. Uploading PDFs: 1 credit per analysis.
Home.footer: Analiza tu juicio — AI-assisted legal analysis. This service does not replace professional legal advice.

Analyze.title: Tell us about your case
Analyze.subtitle: Write what happened and/or upload your documents. We analyze files in Spanish.
Analyze.footer: Your information is confidential and only used to generate the analysis. We do not permanently store your documents.

CaseForm.descriptionPlaceholder: Describe the facts of your case in as much detail as possible: dates, names, what happened, what documents you have, what you're seeking...
CaseForm.creditWithFiles: This analysis will use 1 credit for uploading documents. If you only write the description, it's free.
CaseForm.creditWithoutFiles: Analyzing with description only is free. Uploading documents costs 1 credit per analysis.
CaseForm.tip1: Upload the complete file or the initial complaint
CaseForm.tip2: Include rulings, agreements and prior notifications
CaseForm.tip3: If you have contracts or records, upload them too
CaseForm.errorEmpty: Please describe your case or upload at least one document.
CaseForm.errorCheckout: Could not start payment. Try again.
